design: Male, about 40 years old, American, a low weathered baritone with a little gravel, a grown man's chest voice, quiet and steady, a man of few words, warm underneath, tired but determined, close-mic, clean dry studio audio, natural and conversational, not an announcer.
refText: Fed the horse, checked the water, walked the fence line twice. Nothing moving out there tonight. That's good. Quiet means we all get a little sleep. I'll take first watch.
